feature: Mobile input-to-pose gate and visible pooled projectiles

implementation.input: Assigned IntercomPlayerInput FireHeld/FirePressed replaces mouse/space fallback; external request API remains available
implementation.cancel: Focus/pause, ResetPosture, disable and profile replacement cancel queued pose fire and already queued LateUpdate spawns via FireCancelled; Initialize clears shooter queue; consumption requires active Combat posture.
implementation.spawn: ShotReady queues; LateUpdate after Animator samples actual muzzle positions and +Z directions; two pistols by default
implementation.collision: Body-to-muzzle obstruction check, spawn/start overlaps, swept sphere casts every move; ignores owner hierarchy and triggers; saturated query buffer stops bullet
implementation.pool: Fixed 32 slots by default, shared mesh/material, no Collider/Rigidbody on bullets, bounded life/range; no per-frame managed allocations in shooter
implementation.input_cancel_bridge: WeaponPose observes source identity plus uint CancellationVersion before any dt/focus/Animator early exit. Changed epoch/source cancels pose and queued LateUpdate shots, including timeScale=0, OS cancellation, and layout changes. Normal pointer release preserves a queued short tap. Awake snapshot and Initialize recheck cover pre-Start cancellation.

validation.roslyn_csharp9_syntax: Current project C# syntax parsed under legacy/new/no-input symbol configurations with zero errors; this is not Unity assembly/type compilation.
validation.independent_read_only_review: Collision/allocation/owner filtering reviewed. Reviewer identified same-frame cancellation and Initialize queue gaps; both corrected with FireCancelled, queue clearing and active/Combat guards. Final syntax check passed.
